searches.query: As an active member I want a kayak delivered to my contiguous-US address and two tent pole sections replaced through paid repair. The repair quote separately says shipping is 12 dollars. Does membership make kayak delivery or the repair free? What are the two totals?

chunks.text: Published repair charges  The repair workshop offers a tent pole-section replacement for USD 18 per section and a sleeping-bag zipper-slider replacement for USD 25. These prices cover the named repair work only. Any transport charge is stated in the individual quotation. Other repairs, including a torn tent floor, require a quote after assessment. There is no published flat price for a tent-floor replacement.  A manufacturing fault approved under warranty is handled under the product's warranty terms rather than automatically charged as a paid repair. An accidental tear or wear outside the warranty can still be assessed for paid repair. The workshop tells the customer the scope and price before work begins. The customer must approve the quotation; sending an item for assessment is not approval for an unspecified charge.  Active members receive priority queue handling but pay the same published repair prices. Priority is not a completion guarantee.

Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.

Oversize delivery for kayaks and cargo boxes  Kayaks and rigid roof cargo boxes are oversize products. Delivery to an eligible address in the contiguous United States costs USD 35 per order containing oversize items. Neither the ordinary free-shipping threshold nor the membership threshold waives this fee. Adding a small accessory to the order does not turn the oversize shipment into an ordinary parcel.  Oversize deliveries use a scheduled ground carrier. Express parcel service is not available for these products. The carrier contacts the customer to arrange an appointment after the shipment is ready. The documentation does not provide a fixed appointment date for any particular order. Support must check the live shipment record before discussing an actual delivery appointment.  At delivery, inspect the outer packaging before signing and photograph visible transport damage. If damage is discovered afterward, use the delivery-damage reporting policy. Store pickup may be available for an oversize item when the chosen store has stock.

Kayak delivery total: USD 35 (oversize fee applies regardless of membership). Repair total: USD 48 (USD 18 per section × 2 sections + USD 12 shipping).
